content_of_post_to_comment: I don’t find myself “getting used” to AI. I find myself despising it more and more everyday. Everything about it — particularly generative AI — seems calculated to atrophy some facet of human capacity. Even scarier is how many people, including Christians, have just accepted its intrusion into their lives.
comment: Perhaps the deeper danger isn't that AI makes us less capable, but that it makes dependence feel like convenience. We may not notice what we've surrendered until we can no longer do it ourselves.
